name: std::ranges::destroy

declarations.code:
template <no - throw -input - iterator I,
    no - throw -sentinel - for<I> S >

            requires std::destructible<std::iter_value_t<I>>

        constexpr I destroy(I first, S last) noexcept;

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
first, last

 -

 iterator-sentinel pair denoting the range of elements to destroy


 r

 -

 the range to destroy

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An iterator compares equal to last.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the distance between first and last.
